sentences.text: 3. The petitioner-Committee is not a registered body.

Its grievance is that the statutory provisions under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (in short 'Act, 2013') is not being duly implemented in respect of the villagers of Khapurikachhar.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. In response to a query as to why the individual claims of the villagers is being raised by a Committee, which is not a registered body, under the PIL, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner has submitted that the villagers are poor and they do not have the resources to approach appropriate forum in respect of their individual claims.
5. This application in the nature of PIL, which relates to payment of compensation to individuals under the Act, 2013 is thoroughly misconceived and is, accordingly, dismissed.

6. The interested persons shall be at liberty to approach the concerned Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation, and Resettlement Authority (LARRA).
